First topic. We talked about the crystallization screen and I don't think the sodium chloride gradient helped. The drops dried out after three days.

Second topic. The diffraction data from the synchrotron trip are in. They're good to two angstroms and the space group looks like P 2(1) 2(1) 2(1).

Third topic. The molecular dynamics simulations haven't converged. We'll extend them by another two hundred nanoseconds.

Fourth topic. The manuscript draft needs a new figure for the solvent structure. I'll make it in PyMOL tomorrow.

Fifth topic. The workshop schedule isn't final. We need to book the room and send the announcement.
